textos.Dirigido por Martin Scorsese e lançado e: Directed by Martin Scorsese and released in 2010, Shutter Island is a drama, mystery and thriller production that runs 138 minutes. The story follows two federal marshals who travel to an isolated island in Boston Harbor with the mission of investigating the disappearance of a dangerous killer held in a maximum-security psychiatric hospital. As they begin searching the penitentiary institution, the investigators soon realize that the place hides deep secrets and that the territory holds threats even more dangerous than the patients in custody.
textos.Ao analisar a recepção, nota-se que as a: Looking at the reception, the ratings share a focus on the same central aspects of the work, diverging substantially in the verdict on how it works. In the vast majority of ratings (~89%), most value the construction of an immersive atmosphere marked by isolation and constant unease, while a good portion consider the final twist striking for transforming the meaning of the whole narrative. In this same predominant range, a significant share also highlight Leonardo DiCaprio's performance as a high point, portraying his character's intensity and instability convincingly.
textos.Para os avaliadores situados em uma posi: For the raters in an intermediate position, at a minimal fraction of ratings (~9%), many say the predictability of the twist weakens the experience, while a smaller slice stresses that the slow pace hinders continuous engagement throughout the screening. Also in this segment, a portion of them note that the cast's work delivers strong performances capable of standing out positively.
textos.Para os espectadores com visão desfavorá: For viewers with an unfavorable view, at an even smaller fraction of ratings (~2%), several point out that the dragging pace makes the narrative tiring, a considerable number report disappointment with a predictable conclusion and some criticize what they consider a problematic portrayal of mental health.
